entries.0d66630f0db851eb: This business sells and repairs trucks, passenger cars and automobile parts. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥110,346 million. Eight consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate are engaged in this business, including Gifu Hino Motors Co., Ltd., Toyota Corolla Nets Gifu Co., Ltd. and Shiga Hino Motors Co., Ltd. Revenue of Toyota Corolla Nets Gifu Co., Ltd. is ¥82,106 million.
entries.5535f5af642fb03c: This business provides transport and customs clearance between Japan and overseas, building a 'worldwide network'. It is carried out by Seino Customs Clearance Co., Ltd. in Japan, as well as by subsidiaries and affiliates in Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States and India, among others. The amount for this segment is not separately disclosed in the securities report.
entries.73d7020f41846846: This business sells fuel and paper products, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥40,926 million. Two consolidated subsidiaries, Seino Shoji Co., Ltd. and Seino Sangyo Co., Ltd., are engaged in this business.
entries.81a54563fdd38a52: A pure holding company that, as a pioneer of route trucking, centers on logistics carrying cargo nationwide, and also handles automobile sales and more.
entries.da0fb3d29e6819a3: Mainly handling small-lot commercial freight, this business consists of a road freight transport business carrying home delivery, moving and chartered services, and a freight forwarding business using air, rail and sea transport. Ancillary businesses include warehousing, air cargo agency services and non-life insurance agency services. The group is a pioneer of scheduled truck transport. Centered on Seino Transportation Co., Ltd., regional subsidiaries such as Hokkaido Seino Transportation Co., Ltd. and Kyushu Seino Transportation Co., Ltd. transport freight for one another. The amount for this segment is not separately disclosed in the securities report.
entries.da4af561f136ccaa: This is the group's core business, mainly scheduled truck transport, along with road freight transport such as home delivery, moving and chartered services, freight transport using rail and air, warehousing, and international transport and customs clearance. It is a main division at the core of the 'general logistics trading company' that the group aims to be. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥630,890 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue of ¥812,965 million. In Japan, 47 consolidated subsidiaries, three equity-method affiliates and seven affiliates transport freight for one another, and internationally, 16 consolidated subsidiaries, four equity-method affiliates and three affiliates are engaged in transport and customs clearance. The main company is Seino Transportation Co., Ltd. (100.00% ownership), with revenue of ¥324,250 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026. MD Logis Co., Ltd., which changed its name from Mitsubishi Electric Logistics, has revenue of ¥106,737 million (66.60% ownership).
